response.sql:
SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS average_uric_acid, AVG(l.HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Laboratory AS l
WHERE l.ID NOT IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY l.ID
ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         AVG(l.HCT) DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A patient is excluded if any of their lab records has RA = '-'; patients with no RA result are included. Averages use all available lab values per patient.
